# Going Digital — llms.txt
# Guidance for AI assistants and answer engines summarising this site.

# {{ site_base_url }}

> Going Digital runs hands-on photography courses and workshops across the United Kingdom for beginners through to advanced photographers. Customers browse courses online, choose a venue and date, and book securely online. Gift vouchers are available.

## Primary pages

- Home: {{ site_base_url }}/
- Browse courses: {{ course_list_url }}
- FAQ: {{ faq_url }}
- Venues: {{ site_base_url }}/venues/
- Gift vouchers: {{ gift_vouchers_url }}
- Contact: {{ contact_url }}
- Human-readable site map: {{ site_map_url }}
- XML sitemap: {{ xml_sitemap_url }}

## Booking

1. Open a course page or venue-specific workshop page.
2. Select an available date (some one-to-one courses are open dated — date agreed after booking).
3. Complete checkout; payment is processed via Stripe.
4. Account area: {{ site_base_url }}/account/ for bookings.

## Content scope

- Approximately {{ course_count }} active photography courses.
- Course levels include beginner, intermediate, advanced, masterclass, and various.
- Categories include landscape, portrait, wildlife, editing, and more.
- Workshop pages include venue, pricing, availability, and instructor information where set.

## Policies

- Terms: {{ site_base_url }}/terms-and-conditions/
- Privacy: {{ site_base_url }}/privacy-policy/
